page-services-custom-local-websites.title: Websites built around your business
page-services-custom-local-websites.summary: A custom website helps people find you, understand your work, and take the next step. No templates, no monthly hosting fee, and free monthly checks, upgrades, and changes.

website.title: Your first useful website
website.summary: Start with what you do, who it helps, why people can trust you, and one clear way to contact you. Add more only when it helps a customer act.

maps.title: Get found on Google Maps
maps.summary: A missing listing can come from incomplete details, verification, or conflicting information. Check the facts people see before you make changes.

page-services-it-support.title: Help when business tech breaks
page-services-it-support.summary: If email, Wi-Fi, a card reader, booking, or a device stops working, start with the issue. We assess it and confirm the next step and any on-site timing.

wifi.title: Fix Wi-Fi where work happens
wifi.summary: Walls, interference, and equipment placement can leave weak spots. Test the rooms people use, then check the network layout and device load.

email.title: Keep business email out of spam
email.summary: Spam filters look at domain setup, sending history, message content, and recipient settings. Find the cause before changing how you send.

software.title: When a spreadsheet is not enough
software.summary: Consider custom software when repeated work wastes real time or creates errors, and simpler fixes or current tools cannot solve the job.

brief.title: Start without technical words
brief.summary: Tell us what you are trying to do and where it gets stuck. The first look is free, and any paid work is scoped separately.

platform.title: Choose the right website path
platform.summary: A builder may fit a simple job. Custom help can fit when the customer path, ownership, or upkeep needs more care.

speed.title: Make phone pages load faster
speed.summary: Large images, heavy scripts, fonts, hosting delays, and complex effects can slow a phone page. Check what customers actually wait for.

software-repeat-work.title: Find the real process problem
software-repeat-work.summary: If people disagree about who does what or how exceptions work, new software may only automate confusion. Set the process first.

computer.title: Set up new computers calmly
computer.summary: Prepare approved apps and accounts, decide what must move, and schedule handover around the workday. A staged setup helps reduce disruption.

ownership.title: Keep your website under your name
ownership.summary: Know who controls the domain, hosting, site platform, and connected tools before work begins. A business should be able to reach every important account.

page-services-business-systems.title: Software built for your day
page-services-business-systems.summary: A focused tool can support the way your business already works. You own the software and can see what it is meant to handle.

onsite.title: What happens during a visit
onsite.summary: Start with the symptom, who is affected, and what must keep running. That gives the visit a clear purpose before anything changes.

booking.title: Make booking easy to find
booking.summary: Show the service, important conditions, and what happens after someone reaches out. Put booking where people can see it without hunting.

page-services-tech-consulting.title: Know what to keep or change
page-services-tech-consulting.summary: A free first look at your website, Google profile, tools, and bills can help you decide what to keep, fix, replace, build, or skip.

printer.title: Why one computer cannot print
printer.summary: If some computers print, the printer may be fine. Check the other computer’s network, driver, queue, or permission before replacing equipment.

backup.title: Know your files can return
backup.summary: A backup dashboard is useful, but a successful restore is better proof. Check that important files can actually be recovered.

software-approval-path.title: Keep approvals from disappearing
software-approval-path.summary: When requests get lost across messages, spreadsheets, and memory, a small shared workflow can show the next owner and decision.

album-nyc.title: New York businesses in motion
album-nyc.summary: A visual collection of the shops and daily work that keep New York moving. Explore the details customers need first.

cost.title: What shapes website cost
cost.summary: Website cost follows the work: pages, words, photos, booking or sales tools, connections, and the condition of what already exists. Start with a custom quote.

web-domain-renewal.title: Do not lose your domain
web-domain-renewal.summary: Keep the registrar login, renewal email, payment method, and recovery contact in the business’s control. Review them before a deadline arrives.

human.title: Ask for IT help clearly
human.summary: Say what changed, who is affected, which device or service is involved, and what work is blocked. Never include passwords or private client details.

move.title: Move office tech without surprises
move.summary: Arrange internet before the move. Then plan where network equipment, workstations, and printers will go so the first day can work.

mobile.title: Make your site work on phones
mobile.summary: Text, spacing, navigation, and fixed-width elements can break on a small screen. Review the pages and actions customers use on their phones.

case-venuecircuit.title: VenueCircuit
case-venuecircuit.summary: A project for independent venues that keeps bar, door, staff, and promoter splits in one traceable closeout flow.

it-security-basics.title: Start with practical security basics
it-security-basics.summary: Review unique account access, multi-step sign-in, current devices, a tested backup, and one clear way to report suspicious messages.

web-homepage-priority.title: Make a busy homepage clear
web-homepage-priority.summary: Lead with the problems you solve. Group related services into a few clear paths so a visitor can find their next step.

care.title: Plan useful office check-ins
care.summary: The right schedule depends on how much the office relies on its systems, how often things change, and who already handles updates and backups.

it-guest-network.title: Separate guest and work Wi-Fi
it-guest-network.summary: Guest access and business equipment have different needs. Keeping them separate can make the work network easier to manage.

case-deckspace.title: DeckSpace
case-deckspace.summary: A project for a cruise that brings an onboard guide, guest network, and memory layer into one small world.

forms.title: Find why forms are abandoned
forms.summary: A form can lose people through confusing questions, a technical problem, too many required fields, or uncertainty about what happens next.

web-redesign-decision.title: Rebuild or make focused fixes
web-redesign-decision.summary: A few changes may be enough when a site is maintainable and its basic structure still helps customers. Start by finding the broken path.

it-permission-review.title: Remove former access safely
it-permission-review.summary: Closing an email account may not remove access to cloud folders, shared links, or business apps. Review each place separately.

it-internet-outage.title: Find where the internet problem starts
it-internet-outage.summary: A wired test near the internet equipment can help separate a provider outage from a local Wi-Fi or network issue.

it-account-handoff.title: Handle a departing employee’s laptop
it-account-handoff.summary: Use your business offboarding process before reusing or erasing a laptop. Protect the account, work files, and records first.

page-vera.title: VERA
page-vera.summary: A free NYC rental lens that links listings to public records, flags risk, shows uncertainty, and keeps source records open to inspect.

it-shared-inbox-owner.title: Fix shared inbox sender mix-ups
it-shared-inbox-owner.summary: Shared inboxes can reply from the wrong person when permissions, default sender settings, or personal accounts overlap. Check the setup before sending.

album-marthas-vineyard.title: Martha’s Vineyard, in season
album-marthas-vineyard.summary: A visual collection for island businesses that need clear, current information when the season changes.

web-accessibility-basics.title: Make the first customer path accessible
web-accessibility-basics.summary: Begin with readable text, visible focus, meaningful buttons, usable forms, and information that is available as text, not only inside an image.

web-local-facts.title: Phoenix facts customers can use
web-local-facts.summary: Publish the location details people need to visit or arrange service: accurate contact information and the real service area.

web-proof-before-pitch.title: Give a new customer confidence
web-proof-before-pitch.summary: Show what you do, who is behind the work, and how to get in touch. Clear proof helps people decide what to do next.

web-content-collection.title: Gather what a website needs
web-content-collection.summary: Bring approved service details, current contact information, domain and site access, usable photos, and the questions customers ask most.

it-license-renewal.title: Review software renewals calmly
it-license-renewal.summary: List each tool, its cost, renewal date, account owner, and the job it supports. That makes a renewal easier to evaluate.

web-service-page.title: Answer the service question first
web-service-page.summary: Name the problem, explain the next practical move, show who it fits, and make the first contact step easy to find.

it-password-ownership.title: Keep business accounts straight
it-password-ownership.summary: Personal and business Microsoft or Google accounts can look alike while giving different access. Check which identity owns the work.

web-photos-with-purpose.title: Choose photos that help decide
web-photos-with-purpose.summary: Use photos that show the place, the work, the people, or the result a customer needs to understand.

it-video-call-room.title: Test the room before the call
it-video-call-room.summary: Test the camera, microphone, display, account access, and network in the room where people will actually meet.

it-storage-full.title: Check storage before deleting
it-storage-full.summary: Find what is using space before deleting anything important. A full drive can have several simple causes.

web-menu-and-hours.title: Keep seasonal hours easy to find
web-menu-and-hours.summary: For a Martha’s Vineyard business, show current hours and opening dates where people look for them, including the contact or booking path.

web-events-calendar.title: Give an event the needed facts
web-events-calendar.summary: Say what is happening, when and where it happens, who it is for, what it costs when relevant, and the next step to attend.

it-shared-files.title: Make shared files easier to find
it-shared-files.summary: Organize files around how the team works. Use clear names, clear owners, and the right access for each person.

it-phone-setup.title: Test a new business phone setup
it-phone-setup.summary: Call the public number from another device. Check voicemail, after-hours handling, and who receives messages and returns calls.

web-ecommerce-inventory.title: Prepare a shop to sell online
web-ecommerce-inventory.summary: Define products, stock, payment, and fulfillment before selling. Then give customers accurate descriptions and clear policies.

web-multilingual-start.title: Choose languages your customers use
web-multilingual-start.summary: More languages can help when they match the people you serve and someone can approve the wording before it goes live.

it-software-updates.title: Check every computer gets updates
it-software-updates.summary: Make an inventory of office computers and review update status. Do not assume every device follows the same policy.

it-payment-device-check.title: Find card reader disconnects
it-payment-device-check.summary: Busy times can expose network congestion, weak signal, power trouble, or a payment-service issue. Check the cause before changing equipment.

album-arizona.title: Arizona work, clearly explained
album-arizona.summary: A visual collection for businesses that need a helpful website before the next customer reaches out.

web-site-health-check.title: Check a website update properly
web-site-health-check.summary: After an update, test the pages and customer actions it touched: phone layouts, forms, booking links, and important navigation.

it-domain-email-renewal.title: Track what keeps email running
it-domain-email-renewal.summary: Keep a record of the domain registrar, email provider, billing and recovery contacts, and who is allowed to make changes.

web-hosting-ownership.title: Know hosting before you move
web-hosting-ownership.summary: Before changing providers, know who owns the hosting account and domain, how email depends on it, and what backup choices exist.

it-new-hire-access.title: Set up a new hire well
it-new-hire-access.summary: Prepare only the accounts, devices, files, and instructions the role needs. Test the first real task with the person who manages the work.

it-home-work-boundary.title: Set up a simple home office
it-home-work-boundary.summary: Start with the work that needs to happen, then choose the laptop, monitor, printer, and video-call setup that supports it.

web-reviews-response.title: Reply to reviews like a person
web-reviews-response.summary: Thank someone for a real detail when it fits. Answer useful questions plainly and take private account or order issues off the public page.

web-search-answer.title: Make answers easier to understand
web-search-answer.summary: Name the customer question, answer it with specific current facts, and link to the next useful detail. That helps people and search tools.

it-support-notes.title: Keep a note after a fix
it-support-notes.summary: Write down what happened, what changed, who owns the account or device, and what to check if the problem returns.

web-newsletter-choice.title: Only ask for email with a purpose
web-newsletter-choice.summary: Use a signup when you have useful updates to send and a person responsible for the list. Do not collect addresses without a clear reason.

web-launch-checklist.title: Check the basics before launch
web-launch-checklist.summary: Confirm contact details, the main customer action, phone behavior, domain and hosting ownership, and how messages reach the business.

it-vendor-handoff.title: Prepare for a provider review
it-vendor-handoff.summary: Bring a list of services, account owners, renewal dates, current symptoms, and business times when changes would be risky.

case-chromatic-painting-design.title: Chromatic Painting & Design
case-chromatic-painting-design.summary: One studio identity with separate paths for painting projects and mural commissions.

case-hair-by-rachel-charles.title: Hair By Rachel Charles
case-hair-by-rachel-charles.summary: A salon website that explains services before booking while keeping Square in the booking path.

page-areas.title: Help that knows your block
page-areas.summary: Find website, tech, and software help shaped around small businesses across New York City and the needs of your neighborhood.

case-cc-films.title: CC Films
case-cc-films.summary: An official film home with direct paths for fans, press, and premiere guests.

album-hospitality.title: Hospitality, ready for the next guest
album-hospitality.summary: A visual collection for cafés and restaurants that need menus, visits, and useful contact details to be easy to find.

case-easy-tiger.title: Easy Tiger Bar
case-easy-tiger.summary: A neighborhood-bar site with a readable menu, event paths, visit details, and a separate editing flow for upkeep.

case-the-break-room.title: The Break Room
case-the-break-room.summary: A pool-hall site that pairs venue character with readable games, menu, directions, and contact details.

case-clearhelp.title: ClearHelp
case-clearhelp.summary: A resource-finding site that starts with people’s situations and locations, with a separate route for offering help.

case-after-hours-agenda.title: After Hours Agenda
case-after-hours-agenda.summary: A brand-led streetwear storefront that keeps product, payment, and made-to-order fulfillment connected.

case-all-pets-animal-hospital.title: All Pets Animal Hospital
case-all-pets-animal-hospital.summary: A public project record that keeps private client details withheld until public proof is approved.

case-army-navy-bags.title: Army & Navy Bags
case-army-navy-bags.summary: A phone-first neighborhood field guide for a distinctive local shop.

album-roofing.title: Roofing work, ready for inquiry
album-roofing.summary: A visual collection for roofing businesses that need a visit to lead into a clear, useful inquiry.

case-brothers-pizzeria.title: Brothers Pizzeria
case-brothers-pizzeria.summary: A neighborhood-pizzeria concept with heritage, a full readable menu, and phone ordering together.

case-grand-funding-llc.title: Grand Funding LLC
case-grand-funding-llc.summary: A real-estate funding site that separates project education and planning examples from a transaction-specific review.

case-logan-loans.title: Logan Loans
case-logan-loans.summary: A mortgage-information site with separate routes for buyers, homeowners, investors, and realtors to learn before contacting the lender.

case-legacy-music-group.title: Legacy Music Group
case-legacy-music-group.summary: A music-company release candidate with paths for artists, services, booking, company context, and reference material.

case-pole-position-it.title: Pole Position IT
case-pole-position-it.summary: An active client project whose public proof stays private until its owner approves it.

case-public-house-creative.title: Public House Creative
case-public-house-creative.summary: A private estimating system that brings documents, room classification, price drivers, and reporting into one checkable workspace.

case-surviving-game.title: Surviving Game
case-surviving-game.summary: A public project record that preserves privacy until client-approved proof is available.

album-shops.title: Shops and salons, ready to visit
album-shops.summary: A visual collection for businesses that want the next visit to feel easy to plan.

case-the-tarot-hotline.title: The Tarot Hotline
case-the-tarot-hotline.summary: A personal-service site that explains voice notes, live talks, and a question-first path before someone chooses a paid next step.

lab-pool-room.title: The Pool Room
lab-pool-room.summary: An original 3D New York dive-bar scene that ends with a physics-solved pool break.

lab-terminal-3d.title: Neon District
lab-terminal-3d.summary: An interactive night district with people, cabs, beacons, and changing moments.

lab-walkup-3d.title: Six-Story Walk-Up
lab-walkup-3d.summary: An illustrative New York corner made as one living 3D asset for real estate, games, and cinema.

lab-pill-scroll.title: Scroll Into Motion
lab-pill-scroll.summary: A scroll-controlled visual study that places sixteen New York moments inside one frame.

lab-micro-animations.title: Micro-Animations
lab-micro-animations.summary: Seven interaction studies in an illustrative ordering interface, showing how small feedback can clarify an action.

lab-aha-laser.summary: A responsive poster experiment with a laser-drawn wordmark and a pull-chain interaction.

album-trades.title: Trades businesses, ready for calls
album-trades.summary: A visual collection for the crews and local work that need clear ways to handle incoming requests.

lab-studio-engine.title: Studio Engine
lab-studio-engine.summary: An illustrative business-direction generator that turns a rough idea into a sample creative direction.

page-library.summary: Plain answers for small-business owners: what happened, what it means, and the next small move worth making.

lab-growth-street.summary: An invented flower-shop story that uses interactive visual props to explain one possible path from attention to orders.

lab-goliath.summary: A Little Fight brand experiment that uses ten scroll-controlled street posters to carry one message.

page-industries.summary: Explore websites and practical technology help shaped around the way your business works.

market-nyc.summary: Websites that make the next choice clear, plus support that starts with the interruption and uses plain language.

market-marthas-vineyard.summary: Clear customer paths and calm technology planning for Martha’s Vineyard businesses that need information to stay current.

market-arizona.title: Arizona tools for real work
market-arizona.summary: A clear customer path for the work in front of you, plus support planning built around the real interruption.

album-makers.title: Makers, with value explained
album-makers.summary: A visual collection for makers who need a website to help people understand the work and its value.

market-louisiana-starbase-area.title: Louisiana, clear before the next move
market-louisiana-starbase-area.summary: Practical website decisions and safe technology preparation for the work that is real today.

market-texas-starbase-area.title: South Texas work, easy to find
market-texas-starbase-area.summary: Useful public information and careful support planning for South Texas businesses with work to get done.

market-florida-space-coast.title: Space Coast, useful on first tap
market-florida-space-coast.summary: A strong mobile front door and a calmer plan when the systems behind the work need attention.
